title: Splint Pricing Method by Payer Class and Campus — Insurance Claim (Third-Party Billing)
content:
**Pricing methodology bulletin.** The splint (code A4570 under revenue code 0270) on an Outpatient Surgery Account of the Hospital Account (Encounter Billing), when valued for an Insurance Claim (Third-Party Billing), is priced according to the claim's payer class and the campus of the account, reading its billed units from the account's charge postings:

1. **Commercial PPO Claim for services at Riverbend Surgery & Imaging Center - Grand Chute:** the lesser of its charges and its billed units times 18.40 USD.
2. **Commercial HMO Claim for services at a hospital campus (Riverbend Regional Medical Center - Appleton or Riverbend Lakeshore Hospital - Neenah):** its billed units times 18.40 USD.
3. **Otherwise:** the payer class's expected allowed percentage of its charges.

The splint's value is never above its billed charges.

**Truth table (hypothetical inputs: 2 billed units, charges 30.00)**
| Payer class | Campus | Value |
|---|---|---|
| Commercial PPO Claim | Grand Chute | 30.00 (36.80 exceeds the charges) |
| Commercial HMO Claim | Appleton | 30.00 (36.80 capped at the charges) |
| Commercial PPO Claim | Neenah | expected allowed percentage of 30.00 |
| Marketplace Exchange Plan Claim | Grand Chute | expected allowed percentage of 30.00 |

With 1 billed unit and charges of 12.00, the first two rows give 12.00.
